definitions.comparedTruths: Runner process inventory and active leases
definitions.violation: A process has no lease, or a lease has no process after grace.
definitions.selfHealingAction: Terminate the orphan process; record lease loss for the deployed backend requeue authority.

definitions.comparedTruths: Runner child cwd and host filesystem
definitions.violation: A tracked child cwd is marked deleted.

definitions.comparedTruths: One-minute host load and logical core count
definitions.violation: Normalized load remains above the configured threshold.
definitions.selfHealingAction: Stop new claims while existing runs continue.

definitions.comparedTruths: Progress lane and active run authority
definitions.violation: A Progress task has no active run heartbeat after grace.
definitions.selfHealingAction: Emit the Tranche 0 violation and retain the lane for the deployed backend requeue authority.
